transactions.description: AT&T was the parent company of Warner Media until it was spun off and merged into Discovery, Inc. The resulting entity from the merger is Warner Bros. Discovery and, as part of the consideration for the transaction, AT&T shareholders received shares of the new company based on their AT&T holdings when the transaction closed.
